text:
Earthquake of magnitude 7 strikes Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula
According to EMSC, the quake was at a depth of 140 km (86.99 miles) and took place at about 3.35 pm (local time).
HT News Desk
An earthquake of magnitude 7 struck Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula region on Friday, the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC) said, according to Reuters news agency.
According to EMSC, the quake was at a depth of 140 km (86.99 miles) and took place at about 3.35 pm (local time). The epicenter was 146 km between south and south-west (SSW) of Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky in Russia and 80 km between north and norht-east(NNE) of Ozernovskiy in Russia.
